fields.summary: [Marketplace] Find opportunities using effective filters and sorting

content.text: As a marketplace visitor, I want supported filters and sorting to change the authorized inventory consistently so I can find relevant opportunities.

Acceptance: inspect currently rendered map/deals/table paths, then connect every supported taxonomy/duration/yield/sort control to results; preserve Network deal/tranche context; consistent empty/loading/error states across views; malformed/nullable payload fields do not produce misleading map positions or counts; keyboard and narrow-screen behavior are verified.

Interaction coverage: extend current Browse, TaxonomyInteraction, Empty, Error, Loading and NetworkHandoff stories with actual result assertions, plus API contract fixtures. Source REVIEW.md is a lead to validate, not proof that every old finding is still user-visible.

Discovery scope: EnsuredNetwork backend/frontend/contracts and EnsuredMarketplace package, plus EnsuredUI host, EnsuredAPI projections/commercial workflows and EnsuredAuth gateway. Source review is recorded in docs/data-models/network-marketplace-discovery.md. Existing profiles, social interactions, publication adapters and deal/tranche deep links must be reused. Their presence is code-reviewed, not fresh proof of end-to-end acceptance.

Definition of Done: every child story has actor/intent/benefit and acceptance evidence; all required dependencies and subtasks are reconciled before epic closure. Extend existing Storybook play stories with success, validation, denied/revoked, empty/loading/error and retry cases as relevant. Maintain ticket-to-story mapping. Mocked UI evidence must be accompanied by isolated real-service tests for persistence, identity, tenant isolation and authorization. Record test commands/results and deployment status. No production writes are part of this planning task.
Persona feedback reconciliation — 2026-11-04
Feedback coverage
B4, B5; numbering follows the user conversation.

For market-suitability discovery, show the declared matching criteria, source and last-reviewed/as-of date. Unknown or stale appetite cannot be represented as confirmed willingness to quote. Preserve private appetite and distinguish marketplace opportunity discovery from reinsurer approach decisions.
Definition of Done for this story

All acceptance criteria and the story-specific verification scenario pass; link implementation tasks/PRs and record the reviewed source/package versions. A partial component or newly created ticket does not satisfy this story.

Every changed UI workflow has executable Storybook play functions asserting user actions, observable results and exact submitted payloads, including success, validation, failure/retry, empty/loading, pagination and permission/revocation states where applicable. Document a reason for any nonapplicable state. Include keyboard and narrow-screen checks.

Fixture stories use isolated synthetic transports with accidental application writes blocked. Also run authenticated real-service journeys against isolated Docker databases/services for authorization, durable state, concurrency, idempotency and relevant money invariants. Backend-only work uses integration evidence linked to this story, not artificial UI.

Attach ticket → component → Storybook story IDs → command/results mapping, regression evidence, API/database checks and known coverage gaps to Jira and TASK_HANDOFF.md. New failures have linked bug tickets and regressions; no unresolved failure of an acceptance criterion permits Done.

Reconcile all required dependencies and subtasks. Record migration/backfill compatibility and rollback results when schemas change. Demonstrate the workflow in the integrated staging environment, identifying deployed build and service versions; local checks alone are not staging evidence. Production deployment remains a separate release gate under AIN-1/12.

For external-system or monetary settlement claims, attach configured vendor/provider-sandbox evidence and matched reconciliation; simulated events or manually recorded receipts cannot establish external delivery or settled cash.
Scope
Preserve the original acceptance criteria and implementation ownership. This update adds clarity, not a Done transition.
Single-developer sprint sequence — 2026-11-04
Target candidate: AIN S34 | Effective market discovery (Jira sprint 69).
Sprint outcome: Make supported Marketplace filtering/sorting effective and explain source freshness for matching.
Exit evidence: Map/list/table inventory agrees under filters; unknown/stale appetite is not represented as willingness to quote; permissions and exact source links hold.

Planning envelope: 6 implementation days + 2 integrated verification days + 1 review/refinement day + 1 contingency day; not measured velocity. One primary outcome in progress; at most two closely related workflow slices. Story/task pairs share effort, not double-counted work.

Existing active sprint remains active with original dates; only its goal/name and unfinished membership are reorganized. Every new sprint is future and undated. No fabricated story-point/time estimates or assignees. The ordered slots are a provisional work breakdown, not a fixed delivery forecast. Before activation, split any candidate exceeding six implementation days and verify reviewer/provider readiness; preserve all parent acceptance criteria.

Scheduling is not implementation: original AC/DoD and parent scope are unchanged. Related story/task/subtask effort is one delivery slice, not additive capacity. Required domain slices can be delivered earlier than the broader owner completion sprint; no broader item is Done until all original requirements pass.
